acceptanceCriteria: When zero declared requirements are linked, the report states it in the verdict or in a first-class finding, and a test covers the 0-of-N case.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from agent friction during the AFU S2 dogfood loop. The OCM aggregate reported 0 of 40 declared requirements linked to the change and still returned ready-for-review. A change that links none of its declared intent should at least surface that as a reviewer-visible gap, not look the same as a fully linked change.

completion.reason: Already delivered on main by PR #213 (1d633c9a): OCM emits a no-requirements-linked finding (OCM-V0-016) instead of an unqualified ready-for-review when no requirements are linked. Re-verified 2026-10-08 at main ecfff8e0: TestAggregateFindsNoLinkedRequirements covers 0-of-N, some-of-N and N-of-N; ./internal/dogfoodocm passes. Evidence digests are sha256 of the cited files at ecfff8e0. Manual completion; no new CEM since no source changed.

title: dogfood: OCM reports 0/40 requirements linked and still gives the verdict ready-for-review
